data.status: Accepted planning baseline; production and electrical qualification pending.

scope.os_specification: Accepted phased AIONix2 specification in software.aionix2; implementation and 256 KiB DRAM fit pending qualification.
scope.financial_policy: No new retail prices, sales, investment or ROI calculated by this planning addition. Existing dated forecasts are unchanged.
scope.memory_policy: Shared 32-bit modules: 128 KiB two-rank 16K×1 modules preserve Athena 256 KiB; 256 KiB single-rank 2 µm 64K×1 modules preserve Server 1 MiB. Two modules per independently selected 32-bit capacity bank; qualification pending.
scope.system_rom: 256 KiB minimum directly executable AIONix2 ROM bank plus separate EEPROM BIOS; physical assembly pending.
scope.external_application_rom_cards: No external cartridge slots added; system ROM is distinct from optional application cartridges.
